item.title: Reported layoffs at Morgan Stanley hit mortgage and wealth management units
item.description: Morgan Stanley’s reported layoff of about 3% of its workforce — roughly 2,500 employees — is affecting some staff working on mortgage origination services for wealth management clients.

item.title: Why independent brokerages may have the advantage in real estate’s next chapter
item.description: LeadingRE panelists shared tactics on productivity, culture and coaching, including 28 deals per agent and 24% time gains using AI.

item.title: NAHB data maps modest housing affordability gains in 2025
item.description: NAHB index shows Q4 2025 new home payment at 34% of income, as new home prices fell 2.0% and rates eased to 6.0%.

item.title: Compromise Indiana housing reform law trims local zoning power
item.description: Indiana Gov. Mike Braun swiftly signed into law comprehensive state housing reforms after lawmakers spent weeks debating how much the state could and should override local zoning rules and design standards. The law adopts a softer approach to neutralizing local zoning authority after mayors, county commissioners and municipal planners complained that the initial bill overreached […]

item.title: USDA lending changes could handcuff low-income California homebuyers
item.description: USDA Section 502 Direct Loan caps drop to 60% of local FHA limits, raising concerns about rural homeownership access in California.

item.title: New eXp division bridges homebuilder-brokerage service gap
item.description: eXp New Homes is designed to help agents navigate the complexities of the development process while delivering a higher level of service.

item.title: NAR speaks out on “coming soon” listings
item.description: NAR says it has no national “coming soon” policy, leaving listing status rules to local MLSs and emphasizing MLS benefits for consumers and competition.

item.title: Study finds 65-year-olds need $135K for long-term care
item.description: The type of care — home health, assisted living or nursing home — and where a person lives can drastically affect costs.

item.title: Better launches ChatGPT-based credit decision engine for mortgage and HELOC lenders
item.description: Better.com has launched a conversational credit decision engine that lets mortgage and home equity lenders run underwriting through ChatGPT using the company’s Tinman AI platform.
